description: Run most paid tools with the same input every hour, day or week, and get each result in the owner app, a webhook, ntfy, Discord, Slack or Telegram. Each run is billed at the tool's normal price to your API key's credits (and respects the key's daily limit); failed runs are free. Up to 10 per key. E.g. a morning news_search digest, an hourly crypto_price, a daily domain_report. Costs $0.001 per call, from an API key's prepaid credit (not payable with x402).

deliver.description: Where results go, e.g. {"channel":"app"} or {"channel":"ntfy","target":"my-topic"}. Default: the owner app.

input.description: Its input, exactly as you would call it.

start_at.description: First run (ISO 8601 UTC), e.g. 2026-11-16T08:00:00Z. Default: in 5 minutes.

tool.description: The tool to run, e.g. news_search.

name: schedule_create
title: Schedule a tool to run on repeat
